== Biography ==
Thomas Glasgow, born in 1612, is the son of [[Glasgow-1099|George Glasgow]] and [[Steuart-563|Margaret Steuart]]. Witnesses to his baptism were: William Howie, David Scherrar<ref>Thomas Glasgow

* Surnames: Glasgow, Steuart

Lawful son of George Glasgow and Margaret STEUART

Witnesses: William Howie, David Scherrar</ref> 

=== Family and Descendants ===
Notable events in his life include the births of his children, as detailed in the Old Parish Records:

* '''JANNET''': Born on November 29, 1640, in Linlithgow. (No mother listed)<ref>"Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1RX-G4T : 16 September 2021), Thomas Glasgow in entry for Jannet Glasgow, 1640.</ref> 
* '''JOHN''': Born on February 25, 1644, in Linlithgow. Mother: Hellin Bryse.<ref>"Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1RV-T82 : 16 September 2021), Thomas Glasgow in entry for John Glasgow, 1644.</ref> 

== Research Notes ==
=== Father confidence review, 22 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-1099]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The 15 March 1612 Glasgow baptism names George Glasgow and Margaret Steuart as Thomas’s parents. That exact couple defines the existing George household and the profile’s indexed child. The named couple is substantially more specific than a shared surname.

The recorded 1612 child and George/Margaret parent household. This does not identify him with either later Thomas adult. OPR644/1,10/81; original image uninspected.

Next useful test: Review the separate adult Thomas connections before using them to bridge branches.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1103 Thomas Glasgow  * Record Type: Births & Baptisms * Data Set: Glasgow High Kirk Baptisms 1609-1777 * Baptism Date: 15 March 1612 * Location: Glasgow * Surnames: Glasgow, Steuart * Reference: Vol: 1/754  Lawful son of George Glasgow and Margaret STEUART  Witnesses: William Howie, David Scherrar]. No new original was inspected in this review. This is an assessment of an existing attachment, not a new father.


=== Inveresk father and combined-profile identity ===

The Inveresk father Thomas Glasgow is represented provisionally by [[Glasgow-1103|Thomas Glasgow]]. The Inveresk baptisms identify a Thomas Glasgow household. The 1637 and 1642 entries name Agnes Thomsone/Thomson with Thomas, and William’s 1639 transcript names the same pair. Agnes’s 1634 entry names Thomas only. These children are provisionally attributed to [[Glasgow-1103|Thomas Glasgow]], whose combined profile also contains the Glasgow baptism of 1612 and the Linlithgow family.

The record-defined Inveresk father is Thomas Glasgow, but his identification with the combined [[Glasgow-1103]] profile remains uncertain. That profile also represents the Glasgow child baptised in 1612 and the Linlithgow father associated with Hellin Bryse. A 1612 birth allows ages about 22, 25 and 30 at the Inveresk baptisms, but does not prove that adult identity. The profile’s estimated 1639 Bryse marriage overlaps the Agnes Thomsone household, which continues to December 1642. A later remarriage could fit the 1644 Bryse child, but is not established; a distinct Inveresk Thomas remains an alternative. Jannet’s 1640 Linlithgow entry names no mother. Keep these households distinguishable and do not infer a death or remarriage date.

Agnes’s mother is not named in her indexed entry; her Agnes Thomsone attribution rests on the family reconstruction. Marione’s recorded 13 December birth and 18 December christening are distinct dates. [[Glasgow-3077|James Glasgow]] is a circumstantial naming-pattern placement. [[Glasgow-3050|Margaret Glasgow]] has a conflicting William Glasgow/Bessie Howie index identification and is not corroboration of this sibling group.

The father’s combined identity remains a working reconstruction. [https://glasgow.phenotype.dev/branches/early-scottish-records/#inveresk-thomas-family Family comparison].<ref>Scotland’s People, ''Old Parish Registers, births and baptisms'', [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ supplied index], parish 689: Agnes Glasgow, 27 July 1634, 10/251, father Thomas; Thomas Glasgow, 6 August 1637, 10/300, Thomas Glasgow/Agnes Thomsone; Marione Glasgow, 18 December 1642, 20/23, Thomas Glasgow/Agnes Thomson. Index entries only; original images not inspected. Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4437421&tab=this William Glasgow], born 20 August and baptised 21 August 1639, parents Thomas Glasgow and Agnes Thomson, OPR 689/1, SCOT/OPR/BAP/4437421. The child records establish the named Inveresk household, not the father’s earlier or later identity.</ref>

* Another child, '''THOMAS''', born to Alexander Glasgow and Issobell Anderson on August 12, 1666, in St Cuthbert's, may be related.

== Sources ==
Thomas Glasgow was likely born by about 1615, an estimate based on the timing of his marriage and the birth of his children. His parents have not yet been confirmed by primary sources (see Research Notes).

He married [[Thomsone-70|Agnes Thomsone]]. While their specific marriage record has not been located, their relationship is confirmed by their joint parentage listed in the baptismal records of their children in the Inveresk parish.<ref name="MarriageInferred">Marriage is confirmed by parentage listed in the baptism records of their children in the Inveresk Old Parish Registers between 1634 and 1643.</ref>

Thomas and Agnes had the following children christened in the parish of Inveresk and Musselburgh, Midlothian, Scotland. The christening records for these children can be found in the Old Parish Registers under frame number 259 (OPR 689/1).<ref name="OPR">Old Parish Registers, Inveresk and Musselburgh, Midlothian, Scotland (OPR 689/1), Frame 259. Records for children of Thomas Glasgow and Agnes Thomsone.</ref>
* [[Glasgow-2460|Agnes Glasgow]], christened 27 July 1634.
* [[Glasgow-2461|Thomas Glasgow]], christened 6 August 1637.
* [[Glasgow-2462|William Glasgow]], christened 21 August 1639.
* [[Glasgow-3077|James Glasgow]]. While his christening within this family has not been located, he is attached based on strong circumstantial evidence. Following traditional Scottish naming patterns, James and his wife Helen Clerk named their first known daughter [[Glasgow-3092|Agnes]], christened in 1658, presumably in honor of James's mother, [[Thomsone-70|Agnes Thomsone]].<ref name="Agnes1658">"Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", , FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:F318-T2H : 16 September 2021), James Glesgow in entry for Agnes Glesgow, 1658.</ref>
* [[Glasgow-3049|Marione Glasgow]], christened 18 December 1642.
* [[Glasgow-3050|Margaret Glasgow]], christened 16 November 1643.

Further details regarding Thomas's specific birth date, occupation, or death remain unknown and are goals for future research.

== Research Notes ==
'''Disproven & Unproven Parentage:'''
*   The corresponding FamilySearch Family Tree profile proposes that his parents are James Glasgow and Christina Adamson. However, no primary sources have been found to substantiate this connection for the Thomas Glasgow of Inveresk. This parentage should be considered a speculative clue until a primary record (such as a christening record naming the parents) is located.
*   The person was also previously attached to [[Glasgow-1156|Robert Glasgow I]] and [[Ivey-2264|Deborah Ivey]] of Colonial Maryland.
